items.title: SELF-IDENTIFICATION
items.quote: For the musician, by David, servant of Hashem.
items.text: David could think of no nobler title than “servant of Hashem.” By choosing to identify himself with this title (rather than “king”) he extolled the virtues of humility and devotion. This is a lesson to all of us to live our lives in such a way that we can take pride in calling ourselves “servant of Hashem.”

items.w: נאם פשע לרשע בקרב לבי אין פחד אלהים לנגד עיניו
items.text: “The words of transgression of the wrongdoer, [are known] within my heart. It is important that you understand the forces that affect the wrongdoer so that you can guard against them and influence others to do so
items.title: WRONGDOER

items.w: יהוה בהשמים חסדך אמונתך עד שחקים
items.title: KINDNESS AND FAITHFUNESS
items.quote: Hashem, Your kindness is unto the heavens. Your faithfulness is to the distant skies.
items.text: Because of His attribute of kindness Hashem sustains all living creatures. Because of His attribute of faithfulness Hashem assures the survival of mankind.

items.w: צדקתך כהררי אל משפטך תהום רבה
items.title: JUSTICE AND JUDGMENT
items.quote: Your caring justice is like the mighty mountains. Your judgments are as the vast watery deep.
items.text: Because of His attribute of caring justice Hashem pays special attention to the welfare of deserving individuals. Because of His attribute of judgment Hashem demands accountability from all wrongdoers.

items.title: TRANSIENT KINDNESS
items.quote: You save both man and beast, Hashem.
items.text: In this world Hashem applies a universal attribute of kindness, which is meant for this world only.

items.w: מה יקר חסדך אלהים ובני אדם בצל כנפיך יחסיון
items.title: ETERNAL KINDNESS
items.quote: How precious is Your kindness, O G-d! And the children of man will take refuge in the shelter of Your wings.
items.text: In the next world we will witness Hashem’s attribute of eternal kindness, which is meant for those who are worthy.

items.w: ירוין מדשן ביתך ונחל עדניך תשקם
items.quote: They will receive their fill from the abundance of Your house. And from the stream of Your delights You will give them to drink.

items.w: כי עמך מקור חיים באורך נראה אור
items.quote: For with You is the source of life. In Your light may we be permitted to see the light [of eternal life].

items.w: משך חסדך לידעיך וצדקתך לישרי לב
items.title: SPECIAL GRANT
items.quote: Extend Your kindness into this world to those who know You. And, extend Your caring judgment to the upright of heart.
items.text: Ask Hashem to extend His special kindness into this world and grant you protection from evil so that you can serve Him as you would like.
